name: Ood Sphere

targets.label: up to one creature each opponent controls

oracle_text:
Song of the Ood — Noncreature spells have convoke. (Each creature you tap while casting a noncreature spell pays for {1} or one mana of that creature's color.)
Red-Eye — Whenever chaos ensues, for each opponent, goad up to one target creature that opponent controls. Until your next turn, those creatures can't become tapped unless they're being declared as attackers.
